messages.text: Hi, I cannot access my account after the password reset email expired. Can you help me get back in today?

Yes. I can confirm the reset link expired. Here are the steps: open a new reset request, use the most recent email, and sign in within 15 minutes. If it still fails, reply here and we will unlock the account.
That worked. Can you also confirm whether my billing profile stayed the same?
I checked the billing profile and it stayed the same. Your current plan, card, and renewal date are unchanged.
I was charged twice and this is frustrating. The issue is still unresolved and the delay is unacceptable.
We are looking into it. Another team will reach out later.
That does not answer my refund question. I need to know when the incorrect charge will be fixed.
As previously stated, someone will reach out. I cannot comment on timing.
Can you tell me why my export failed and whether I can retry without losing data?
The export failed because the file exceeded the current size limit. You can retry after splitting the file into smaller batches.
Will the retry take effect immediately?
It should usually take effect immediately, although there could be a short delay while the queue clears.
